38141442: Disconnect is an iOS app that uses human accountability to help people spend less time on their phones. Where most screen time apps put the user in charge of their own limits — making it trivially easy to cheat — Disconnect brings in a trusted friend as a buddy. When the user tries to unlock a blocked app early, their buddy gets a push notification and approves or denies it with one tap. That single human in the loop is what makes it work. Disconnect uses a three-tier system: Soft lock offers a gentle reminder; Medium lock adds a 5-minute cooldown; Hard lock is where the buddy comes in. Setup takes under two minutes, with no ongoing attention required. It is free to download, with in-app purchase for the full feature set. Disconnect is made by Bytehood Ltd. and available on the App Store.
